description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink messaging, including message parameters, frame parsing, and socket communication, specifically for Linux systems. It includes classes for Netlink message construction, parsing, and socket management, with support for connector messages and rtnetlink.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class for Netlink message handling, including serialization, deserialization, and message parameters.

classes.name: Netlink::Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Netlink::Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames within a data buffer.

classes.name: Netlink::ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message parsing.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Derived class managing Linux Netlink socket communication, including sending, receiving, and message exchange.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the constructed message.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new attribute to the message buffer.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current frame is valid.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next message frame.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the message type.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the message sequence number.

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Returns message flags.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message data.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the message payload.

methods.name: RawData
methods.description: Returns raw message data.

methods.name: RawSize
methods.description: Returns the size of raw message data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes message data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads message data from a stream buffer.

methods.name: Acknowledge
methods.description: Returns acknowledgment number for connector messages.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests a stream of data into the message object.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs a send and receive operation over the socket.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data frames.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes.
